lede: Your employees ask a question in plain language; they get a sourced answer from your intranet, your files or your databases — instead of hunting through folders or asking the one colleague who knows. I design it, build it, and run it on your cloud.
s1_body: Semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation over corporate content: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector databases, relevance you can measure.
s2_body: MCP servers that connect assistants to your platforms and data, agentic workflows, and sandboxed coding agents with the guardrails security teams ask for.
s3_body: Terraform on Azure, GCP, AWS and Hetzner; APIs, identity and token exchange between web applications; Python, Rust and React from prototype to production.
approach_1: I am allergic to the improper use of the word AI. I like statistics, natural language processing, search engines and language models — and I like them most when they solve a measurable problem.
approach_2: I work alongside your teams, write code that stays maintainable after I leave, and prefer open source and local-first tools wherever they fit.
oss_varda: Rust CLI that routes markdown tasks to AI agents and runs them in sandboxed containers or microVMs.
oss_switchboard: one API for Signal, WhatsApp and Telegram messaging.
oss_gdrive: upload and export Google Drive files using Drive's own converters.
oss_tessera: a macOS window manager in Rust, built around real Mission Control Spaces.
talk_lockfiles: a history of virtualenvs and lockfiles.
headline: I build AI assistants and search engines that answer from your company's own documents and tools.
ex1_body: a chatbot that answers employees' questions from a digital workplace's documentation, with links to the sources.
ex2_title: Plugging the intranet into Claude and ChatGPT
ex2_body: a connector (MCP server) that lets employees search, read and publish intranet content straight from their AI assistant, within their own permissions.
ex3_body: semantic search over a development bank's public publications, finding passages by meaning rather than keywords.
ex4_body: Terraform-managed Azure infrastructure for a financial platform: private networking, APIs, databases, reproducible environments.
e1_body: Where the knowledge lives, who needs it, and what a good answer looks like.
e2_body: Real questions on your real content within a few weeks, so you can judge on results.
e3_body: Hosted on your cloud, with access control, monitoring, and a team that can maintain it.
